content_fields.title: Verify backup archive bits are protected
content_fields.description: Verify that backup archives are protected.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming backups are encrypted, that access to the backup store is restricted and logged, and that a restore has been exercised recently.
content_fields.found: No backup process exists to inspect.
content_fields.missing: A backup process and its storage location.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification has no subject until backups are defined.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should verify backup protection once backups exist.
